biotools.summary: SpatialRNA is a Python package designed for generating graphs and subgraphs from spatial RNA molecules in tissue samples, facilitating the application of Graph Neural Network models. It provides comprehensive tutorials for users to perform various analyses and interpretations of single-molecule spatial transcriptomics data.
